verdict.rationale: dlt provides dlt-init-openapi to generate a REST connector from an OpenAPI spec handling auth and pagination via the rest_api source, plus an AI Harness with skills/MCP servers explicitly designed to let coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) build production-grade pipelines from natural-language API descriptions, and dltHub's auditable, human-reviewable run/deploy workflow supports the 'review and ship' step. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually drafting a full connector end-to-end (auth+pagination+streams) from raw API docs rather than an OpenAPI spec, and community corroboration of the AI Harness workflow.
